claims: The 2026 NCAA Men’s Frozen Four is hosted at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, NV.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Frozen Four national semifinals are on April 9, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Frozen Four championship game is on April 11, 2026.
Denver will face Wisconsin in the 2026 NCAA Men’s Frozen Four championship game.
Semifinal 1 on April 9: Wisconsin 2, North Dakota 1.
National Championship on April 11: Denver vs. Wisconsin at T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas.
Venue of the 2026 Frozen Four: T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, NV.
Teams in the 2026 Frozen Four: Denver, Wisconsin, Michigan, and North Dakota.
Regional sites leading up to the 2026 Frozen Four final: Albany, NY, Loveland, CO, Sioux Falls, SD, and Worcester, MA.
Tickets for the 2026 Frozen Four are available through NCAATickets.com and On Location.
Kent Anderson scored the game-winner in Denver's double-overtime win against Michigan.
Johnny Hicks made 49 saves in Denver's game against Michigan.
Wisconsin defeated North Dakota 2-1 on the back of two quick first-period goals.
